simulation.note: ゲーム内の簡易演出用モデルであり、実際の調理安全性を保証する温度計ではありません。

features: complete restaurant kitchen environment with tiled walls, shelves, lamps and stainless preparation island
3D raw pork loin with fat cap and marbling, seasoning shakers and breading bowls
chef knife with steel blade and wooden handle
whole cabbage, outer leaves and individually modelled shredded cabbage
gas stove, stainless frying pan, oil, animated bubbles and tonkatsu with panko crumbs
finished meal with plate, cutlet slices, rice, miso soup, cabbage garnish and sauce
3D customer with face, hair, shirt, apron, chair and animated eating reaction
stage-aware camera views, drag-to-rotate and responsive layout
rendering.requirement: Three.js is loaded from jsDelivr CDN; internet connection is required for the 3D scene.
